headline: Both chambers hold brief pro forma sessions as August recess continues across Capitol Hill.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session for 32 seconds on Monday, August 24, with no legislative business conducted. The chamber will remain largely dormant through the August recess period.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly at 9 a.m. and adjourned at 9:03 a.m. on Monday, August 24, with no votes held. Eleven public bills (H.R. 10138-10148) and four resolutions were introduced, but no substantive floor activity occurred as members remain on recess.
